No producer import.

Independently decode all four original workbooks, exact source-age numeric cell types/rows, reversals and duplicate labels, missing age fields and literal metadata endpoint diagnostic; compare complete typed report and exact publication bytes. No source correction.

FLINK sign discrepancy, HOLK reversals, RANV/STAV absence of workbook ages, negative BP coverage/refusal and source bounds remain unchanged.

No original LandClim historical-input identity, dated basin/denominator, rights, independent ground truth, human approval or LRA/event admission. Private workbook/archive/intake identities remain source custody and are not redistributed.
authority: Independent held-source peer before root-owned source preparation, unique registry/readback and separate native launch; collect actual four-stage terminal before retained/report admission.
